fields.label: Enable ERP Assistant
fields.description: Registered staff numbers (WA ERP User) can search ERPNext and act on documents from WhatsApp.

fields.label: Understand Plain Language (AI)
fields.description: Uses the provider in WA AI Settings to understand free-text requests. Only the message text and document IDs are sent to the AI, never document contents. Exact commands work without AI.

fields.label: Command Prefix
fields.description: Optional, e.g. 'erp'. When set, only messages starting with it go to the assistant, so the same number can also chat as a normal contact. Blank = every message from a registered number.

fields.label: Remember Context For (minutes)
fields.description: How long 'it' and list numbers refer to the last document / list.
